reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a human ear with an in-ear dot and sound waves, the standard symbol for hearing, audiology, and hearing aids. It is ideal for tasks involving ear health, hearing tests, hearing aid maintenance, audio accessibility, or musical ear training, while distinct from general headphones or speaker icons.

distinguishing: Has two concentric curved arcs behind the ear representing radiating sound waves or active listening, whereas the other icon has only a single curved bar representing a behind-the-ear hearing aid casing. For general hearing, audiology, or listening tasks, the two icons are largely interchangeable.
